services.name: Salmon River - Full Day - Advanced Level (Class IV)
services.desc: SPRING/EARLY SUMMER ONLY SOMES BAR, CA Put-in: USFS Butler Ledge river access Take-out: Oak Bottom or Big Ike Difficulty: Class IV Length: 7 miles Known locally as “the slamming salmon” this spring time run is epic! Butler is the true classic run of the Cal-Salmon, as it has a general big water class IV character with two larger rapids sprinkled in. The Butler Ledge run, our guides’ favorite, starts off fast and furious with the class III-IV “miracle mile” and continuous constant action. Things ease up with more class III+ pool drop action all the way through the Gapping Maw (IV+) and 6 Hours • Incl. Lunch • Class lV • Ages 16+

services.name: Dinner River Trip - Class ll or lll
services.desc: Our Farm to Table Dinner Cruises showcase the two things we are most passionate about: pristine rivers and local organic California cuisine. Join us for a one-of-a-kind experience that begins with either: A bunch of exciting whitewater rapids on the Upper Trinity River Pigeon Point Section, and ends with an equally beautiful farm to table style dinner served on the beach. Or, a relaxing Scenic Class ll Float followed by dinner served to you riverside on a sandy beach. These trips are ideal for couples and groups wanting a more romantic and/or relaxing river experience. All of the produce Class lll River Trip w/ Riverside Farm to Table Dinner

services.name: River Guide School - Monday May 24th - Friday May 28th, 2027
services.desc: Monday May 18th- Friday May 22nd, 2026 What: We will teach you all the basics on being a professional commercial whitewater raft guide. This class will include outdoor classroom and lots of hands-on practice on the river, as well some ropes instruction on land. At the end you will have to basic knowledge to apply for a job as a whitewater raft guide, and or take your friends and family out safely on the river. Training will include but isn't limited to how to: Preparing and Rigging a Raft for a day on the water Steering a raft with a paddle, also known affectionately as 'stick guiding' Five Days • 9am to 5pm Daily • Ages 18+

Many people fall in love with the Trinity River and the rafting experience on this run. Group rates do apply. There is no minimum age limit for this trip. blurb: Six Rivers Rafting offers guided whitewater rafting and inflatable kayak trips on the Trinity, Klamath, Salmon, Smith, and Eel Rivers in Northern California. Trips range from half-day to multi-day adventures, including scenic and challenging class II to V rapids. All trips include gear, guides, meals on multi-day trips, and focus on safety and environmental stewardship.
